label: storage rack A
research_purpose: Blocks the left half of the aisle and forces the first lateral deviation. Its flat 2.4 m face is also the primary calibration target for the lidar: a plane returns a predictable range profile, unlike a cylinder.

label: storage rack B
research_purpose: Mirrors rack A on the right, forcing a second deviation the other way, so a policy cannot succeed by committing to one side.

label: structural column
research_purpose: Off-route building column. Provides a fixed, precisely known square return for sector calibration and adds a wall-clearance hazard near the right boundary.

label: structural column
research_purpose: Mirror column near the left boundary, late in the route.

label: crate stack
research_purpose: Low stacked pallet load just off the final approach. Tests whether the policy keeps clearance while converging on the goal, and gives a short, wide return close to the goal pad.

label: powered transfer cart
research_purpose: The dynamic hazard. Crosses the aisle perpendicular to the drone's intended direction of travel at a constant speed, so the free space at x = 5.1 m is a function of time and the policy must solve a timing problem rather than a purely geometric one.

label: start pad
research_purpose: Episode origin; collision-free, 2.25 m from the nearest rack

label: goal pad
research_purpose: Success when the drone centre is within the tolerance radius
